Source: Using the Demographic Health Survey of Burkina Faso (2014) and Nigeria (2013), this paper examines the influence of school education on contraception use among sexually active male and female adolescents aged 15-19 in Burkina Faso and Nigeria.
Luganda: Nga bakozesa Okunoonyereza kw’Ebikwata ku Byobulamu mu Burkina Faso (2014) ne Nigeria (2013), olupapula luno lwekenneenya obuyigirize bw’omu ssomero bye kutuusa ku nkozesa y’enkola z’ekizaalaggumba mu bavubuka abalenzi n’abawala abeegatta nga bali wakati w’emyaka 15-19 mu Burkina Faso ne Nigeria.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú lílo àyèwò onílera tó jẹ mọ irúfẹ́ èèyàn pàtó ní Burkina Faso (2014) àti Nigeria (2013), ìwé yìí ń ṣàyèwọ̀ ipa ẹ̀kọ́ ìwé lórí ìlò ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ láàárín àwọn ọ̀dọ́ lọ́kùnrin àti lóbìnrin tó ti ń ní ìbálòpọ̀ ní ọ̀dún 15-19 ní Burkina Faso àti Nigeria.
Zulu: Kusetshenziswa Inhlolovo Yezempilo Ngokwenani Labantu yaseBurkina Faso (2014) kanye neyaNigeria (2013), leli phepha lihlola umthelela wemfundo yesikole ekusetshenzisweni kwesivikelanzalo phakathi kwentsha esafufusa yabesilisa nabesifazane ebenza ucansi abaneminyaka engu-15-19 ubudala eBurkina Faso naseNigeria.
Hausa: Ta yin amfani da Binciken Alƙaluman Lafiya na Burkina Faso na shekarar (2014) da na Nijeriya na shekarar (2013), wannan takarda ta yi nazarin tasirin ilimin makaranta a kan amfani da maganin hana haihuwa tsakanin matasa maza da mata masu jima'i masu shekaru 15-19 a Burkina Faso da kuma Nijeriya.
Northern Sotho: Tšhomišo ya Diphatišišo tša Dipalopalo tša Maphelo tša Burkina Faso (2014) le Nigeria (2013), sengwalwa se sekaseka khuetšo ya thuto ya sekolong go tšhomišo ya dithibelapelegi magareng ga bafsa ba banna le ba basadi bao ba tsenelago tša thobalano ba mengwageng ye 15-19 nageng ya Burkina Faso le ya Nigeria.
Amharic: የቡርኪናፋሶ (2014) እና የናይጄሪያ (2013) የስነ-ህዝብ ጤና የዳሰሳ ጥናትን በመጠቀም፣ ይህ ጥናታዊ ወረቀት በቡርኪናፋሶ እና በናይጄሪያ፣ በትምህርት ቤት ስለ ወሊድ መከላከያ ዘዴዎች መማር ከ15-19 የእድሜ ክልል ያሉ እና የግብረስጋ ግንኙነት የጀመሩ ወንድ እና ሴት ታዳጊ ወጣቶች ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ ይመረምራል፡፡

Source: The standard estimates using Probit regressions suggest that achieving a primary school education increases the probability of a sexually active adolescent to use contraception by 8.26 percentage points (Burkina Faso) and 17.2 percentage points (Nigeria).
Luganda: Emiwendo egiteeberezebwa nga bakozesa Probit regressions giraga nti okusoma pulayimale kyongera ku mikisa gy’omuvubuka eyeegatta okukozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba ebitundu 8.26 ku kikumi (Burkina Faso) n’ebitundu 17.2 ku kikumi (Nigeria).
Yoruba: Àfojúsùn gbẹ̀ndéke pẹ̀lú ìlò módéèlì tó maa ń gbé èsì jáde lọ́nà méjì pàtó ń dábàá pé níní ẹ̀kọ́ iléèwé àkọ́bẹ̀rẹ̀ ń jẹ́ kí ìṣeéṣe àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tó ti ń ní ìbálòpọ̀ lo ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ pẹ̀lú ìdá 8.26 (Burkina Faso) àti ìdá 17.2 (Nigeria).
Zulu: Izilinganiso ezijwayelekile zisebenzisa iPholobhikhesheni ziphakamisa ukuthi ukuzuza imfundo yesikole samabanga aphansi kwandisa amathuba okuthi intsha esafufusa eyenza ucansi isebenzise isivikelanzalo ngamaphesenti ayi-8.26 (eBurkina Faso) namaphesenti ayi-17.2 (eNigeria).
Hausa: Daidaitaccen ƙiyasi ta amfani da koma baya na Probit ya nuna cewa samun ilimin firamare yana ƙara yiwuwar matasa masu jima'i don yin amfani da maganin hana haihuwa da kashi 8.26 (Burkina Faso) da kashi 17.2 (Nijeriya).
Northern Sotho: Dikakanyo tša motheo tše di šomišago go mpefala ga seemo ga Probit ba šišinya gore go atlega go thuto ya sekolo sa poraemari go oketša kgonagalo ya gore mofsa yo a tsenelago tša thobalano a šomiše dithibelapelegi ka dintlha tša diphesente tše 8.26 (Burkina Faso) le dintlha tša diphesente tše 17.2 (Nigeria).
Amharic: የፕሮቢት ምልሰቶችን በመጠቀም ግምቶችን የሚያቀርበው መስፈርት እንደሚጠቁመው፣ የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ ትምህርትን ማግኘች የግብረስጋ ግንኙነት የጀመረን ታዳጊ ወጣት የወሊድ መከላከያ ዘዴዎችን የመጠቀም ይሆንታ (በቡርኪናፋሶ) በ8.26 የፐርሰንቴጅ ነጥቦች (በናይጄሪያ) ደግሞ በ17.2 የፐርሰንቴጅ ነጥቦች ይጨምረዋል፡፡

Source: This effect increases to 20.3 percentage points (Burkina Faso) and 34.7 percentage points (Nigeria) for adolescents with a secondary or higher school education.
Luganda: Kino kyeyongera okutuuka ku bitundu 20.3 ku kikumi (Burkina Faso) ne 34.7 ku kikumi (Nigeria) mu bavubuka abasomye Haaya n’okusingawo.
Yoruba: Ipa yìí lékún í ìdá 20.3 (Burkina Faso) àti ìdá 34.7 (Nigeria) fún àwọn ọ̀dọ́ t́ó ní ẹ̀kọ́ iléèwé girama àti gíga.
Zulu: Lo mphumela ukhuphuka ufike kumaphesenti anga-20.3 amaphuzu (e-Burkina Faso) namaphesenti angu-34.7 amaphuzu (e-Nigeria) entsheni esafufusa enemfundo yasesekondari noma ephakeme.
Hausa: Wannan tasirin ya ƙaru zuwa kashi 20.3 (Burkina Faso) da maki 34.7 (Nijeriya) ga matasa masu karatun sakandare ko makarantun gaba da sakandare.
Northern Sotho: Seabe se se hlatlogela go dintlha tša diphesente tše 20.3 (Burkina Faso) le dintlha tša diphesente tše 34.7 (Nigeria) go bafsa bao ba phethilego thuto ya sekolo sa sekontari goba sa godimo.
Amharic: ተጽእኖው ሁለተኛ እና ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ባላቸው ታዳጊ ወጣቶች 20.3 የፐርሰንቴጅ ነጥቦች (ቡርኪናፋሶ) እና 34.7 የፐርሰንቴጅ ነጥቦች (ናይጄሪያ) ጨምሮ ነበር፡፡

Source: However, these baseline estimates are biased because adolescents’ decision to engage into sexual activity is not random.
Luganda: Wabula, emiwendo gino egitandikirwako girimu kyekubiira kubanga okusalawo kw’abavubuka okwegatta tekusalwawo mulundi gumu.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, àwọn àfojúsùn paríparí yìí ò ṣòótọ́ nítorí pé ìpinnu àwọn ọ̀dọ́ láti ní ìbálolpọ̀ kìí ṣe ohun tó wáyé láì létò.
Zulu: Kodwa-ke, lezi zilinganiso eziyisisekelo zichemile ngoba isinqumo sentsha esafufusa sokwenza ucansi asizenzeki.
Hausa: Duk da haka, waɗannan ƙiyasi na asali suna da son zuciya saboda shawarar da matasa suka yanke na yin jima'i ba da ka ba ne.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, dikakanyo tše tša motheo di tšea lehlakore ka gore go tšea sephetho ka bafsa sa go amega go mediro ya tša thobalano ga go dirwe ka sewelo.
Amharic: ነገር ግን እነዚህ የመነሻ ግምቶች አድሏዊ ነበሩ ምክንያቱም ታዳጊ ወጣቶች የግብረስጋ ግንኙነት ውስጥ ለመሳተፍ የሚያደርጉት ውሳኔ የዘፈቀደ አይደለም፡፡

Source: In light of this, a Heckman Correction Model (HCM) has been applied to account for this selection bias.
Luganda: Olw’ensonga eno, enkola ya Heckman Correction Model (HCM) yakozesebwa okunnyonnyola kyekubiira ono mu kusalawo.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú èyí Módẹ́ẹ̀lì àtúnṣe Heckman (HCM) ti jẹ́ lílò lá́ti ṣe àkọọ́lẹ̀ fún yíyàn ojúṣáájú yìí.
Zulu: Ngenxa yalokhu, iModeli kaHeckman Yokulungisa Ukuchema (HCM) isetshenziswe ekuphenduleni kulokhu kukhetha okuchemile.

Source: The results show that the Probit regressions underestimate the effect of education on adolescents’ likelihood to use contraception in Burkina Faso and overestimate this effect in Nigeria.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa biraga nti Probit regressions zikkakkanya ebireetebwa obuyigirize ku mikisa gy’abavubuka okukozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba mu Burkina Faso ate ne zisukkulumya ebireetebwa bino mu Nigeria.
Yoruba: Èsì náà fi hàn pé Módẹ́ẹ̀lì tó maa ń gbé èsì jáde ní ọ̀nà méjì pàtó ò bìkítà fún ipa tí ẹ̀kọ́ ni lórí ìṣeéṣe àwọn ọ̀dọ́ láti lo ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ ní Burkina Faso, ó sì ipa tó pọ̀ jù ní Nigeria.
Zulu: Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi iPholobhikhesheni ibukela phansi umthelela wemfundo emathubeni entsha esafufusa yokusebenzisa isivikelanzalo e-Burkina Faso futhi iwubukela phezulu ngokweqile lo mphumela eNigeria.
Hausa: Sakamakon ya nuna cewa masu fafutukar kare haƙƙin ɗan’adam sun raina tasirin ilimi a kan yiwuwar matasa suna yin amfani da maganin hana haihuwa a Burkina Faso tare da yin la'akari da hakan a Nijeriya.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo di laetša gore go mpefala ga seemo ga Probit go tshediša mahlo seabe sa thuto go kgonagalo ya bafsa ya go šomiša dithibelapelegi go la Burkina Faso le go hlohleletša ka phetelelo seabe se go la Nigeria.
Amharic: ውጤቶቹ እንደሚያሳዩት የፕሮቢት ምልሰቶች በቡርኪናፋሶ ትምህርት በታዳጊ ወጣቶች የወሊድ መከላከያ ዘዴዎችን የመጠቀም አዝማሚያ ላይ ያለውን ተጽእኖ አሳንሰው የሚገምቱ ሲሆን በናይጄሪያ ያለውን ተጽእኖ ደግሞ አተልቀው ይገምታሉ፡፡

Source: Their results showed that in Burkina Faso, 57.2% of the youth had no education, 20% had primary school and 22.8% secondary.
Luganda: Bye baazuula byalaga nti mu Burkina Faso, ebitundu 57.2% eby’abavubuka tebaasomako, 20% baasoma pulayimale ate 22.8% siniya.
Yoruba: Èsì wọn fi hàn pé ní Burkina Faso, 57.2% àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ni ò kàwé, 20% kàwé àkọ́bẹ̀ẹ̀rẹ̀, 22.8% sì kàwé girama.
Zulu: Imiphumela yabo iveze ukuthi eBurkina Faso, ama-57.2% entsha abengafundile, ama-20% anezikole zamabanga aphansi nama-22.8% wesekondari.
Hausa: Sakamakonsu ya nuna cewa a Burkina Faso, kashi 57.2% na matasa ba su da ilimi, kashi 20% na makarantun firamare, kashi 22.8% na sakandare.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tša bona di laeditše gore go la Burkina Faso, 57.2% tša bafsa ga se ba tsena sekolo, 20% ba tsene sekolo sa poraemari le 22.8% ba tsene sekolo sa sekontari.
Amharic: ውጤታቸው እንደሚያሳየው በቡርኪናፋሶ 57.2% ያህል ወጣቶች ምንም ትምህርት አልነበራቸውም፤ እና በቅደም ተከተል 20% የመጀመሪያ ደረጃ እና 22.8% ደግሞ የሁለተኛ ደረጃ ትምህርት ነበራቸው፡፡

Source: In Nigeria, only 6.7% of youth had no education.
Luganda: Mu Nigeria, ebitundu 6.7% byokka eby’abavubuka be bataasomako.
Yoruba: Ní Nigeria, 6.7% àwọn ọ̀dọ́ nìkan ni ò káwé.
Zulu: ENigeria, ama-6.7% kuphela entsha engafundanga.
Hausa: A Nijeriya kashi 6.7% na matasa ne kawai ba su da ilimi.
Northern Sotho: Go la Nigeria, ke fela 6.7% tša bafsa bao ba bego ba se ba tsena sekolo.
Amharic: በናይጄሪያ 6.7% ያህል ወጣቶች ምንም ትምህርት አልነበራቸውም፡፡

Source: They found that more youth in Nigeria (38.4%) used contraceptives than in Burkina Faso (26%).
Luganda: Baakizuula nti abavubuka bankgiko mu Nigeria (38.4%) baali bakozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba okusinga mu Burkina Faso (26%).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ri pé àwọn ọ̀dọ́ púpọ̀ ní Nigeria (38.4%) ń lo àwọn ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ ju ní Burkina Faso lọ (26%).
Zulu: Bathole ukuthi intsha eningi eNigeria (38.4%) isebenzisa izivikelanzalo kunaseBurkina Faso (26%).
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa yawancin matasa a Nijeriya kashi (38.4%) sun yi amfani da maganin hana haihuwa fiye da na Burkina Faso kashi (26%).
Northern Sotho: Ba hweditše gore bafsa ba bantši ka Nigeria (38.4%) ba šomišitše dithibelapelegi go feta ka Burkina Faso (26%).
Amharic: በናይጄሪያ ከፍተኛ ቁጥር ያላቸው ወጣቶች (38.4%) ከቡርኪናፋሶ ይልቅ (26%) የወሊድ መከላከያ ዘዴዎችን እንደሚጠቀሙ አግኝተዋል፡፡

Source: The researchers said only 10.1% of uneducated youth in Burkina Faso, and 0.7% in Nigeria, used contraception.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti ebitundu 10.1% byokka eby’abavubuka abataasoma mu Burkina Faso, ne 0.7% mu Nigeria, be baali bakozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé 10.1% àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ti ò kàwé ní Burkina Faso, àti 0.7% ní Nigeria, ń lo àwọn ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathe ama-10.1% kuphela entsha engafundile eBurkina Faso, nama-0.7% eNigeria, esebenzisa izimvikelanzalo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kashi 10.1% na matasan da ba su yi karatu ba a Burkina Faso, da kashi 0.7% a Nijeriya ne kawai suke amfani da maganin hana haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore ke fela 10.1% tša bafsa bao ba sego ba tsena sekolo go la Burkina Faso, le 0.7% go la Nigeria, bao ba šomišitšego dithibelapelegi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት 10.1% በቡርኪናፋሶ ያልተማሩ ወጣቶች እና በናይጄሪያ ደግሞ 0.7% ያህል የወሊድ መከላከያ ዘዴዎችን ይጠቀማሉ፡፡

Source: They observed that youth in Nigeria became sexually active earlier (15.66 years old) than in Burkina Faso (16.3 years old).
Luganda: Baakizuula nti abavubuka mu Nigeria baatandikanga mangu okwegatta (ku myaka 15.66 egy’obukulu) okusinga mu Burkina Faso (ku myaka 16.3 egy’obukulu).
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí pé́ àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Nigeria ti ń ní ìbálòpọ̀ ṣáájú (ọdún 15.66) ti Burkina Faso (ọdún 16.3).
Zulu: Baqaphela ukuthi intsha yaseNigeria yaqala ukwenza ucansi ngaphambi kwesikhathi (iminyaka eyi-15.66 ubudala) kunaseBurkina Faso (iminyaka eyi-16.3 ubudala).
Hausa: Sun lura cewa matasa a Nijeriya suna fara yin jima'i da wuri (shekaru 15.66) fiye da na Burkina Faso ('yan shekara 16.3).
Northern Sotho: Ba lemogile gore bafsa ba Nigeria ba thomišitše go amega go tša thobalano pele (mengwaga ye 15.66) go feta ba Burkina Faso (mengwaga ye 16.3).
Amharic: ከቡርኪናፋሶ (16.3 አመት) ይልቅ በናይጄሪያ ያሉ ወጣቶች ቀደም ብለው (15.66 አመት ሆነው) የግብረስጋ ግንኙነት እንደሚጀምሩ አስተውለዋል ፡፡

Source: However, only in Nigeria were those who became sexually active earlier more likely to use contraceptives.
Luganda: Wabula, mu Nigeria yokka abaatandikanga okwegatta amangu gye baali basuubirwa okukozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba.
Yoruba: Síbẹ̀síbẹ̀, ní Nigeria nìkan ni àwọn tó tètè bẹ̀rẹ̀ sí ní ní ìbálòpọ̀ ṣeéṣe láti lo àwọn ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Kodwa ke, kuseNigeria kuphela lapho labo abaqala ukuya ocansini ngokushesha babesethubeni elihle lokusebenzisa izimvikelanzalo.
Hausa: Sai dai a Nijeriya ne kawai waɗanda suka fara jima'i tun da wuri suka fi yin amfani da maganin hana haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, ke fela ka Nigeria moo bao ba thomilego go amega go tša thobalano peleng go nago le kgonagalo ya gore ba ka šomiša dithibelapelegi.
Amharic: ነገር ግን የወሊድ መቆጣጠሪያ ዘዴዎችን የመጠቀም ከፍተኛ አዝማሚያ የነበራቸው ቀደም ብለው የግብረስጋ ግንኙነት በናይጄሪያ የጀመሩት ብቻ ናቸው፡፡

Source: The researchers also found that, in both countries, those with more than one partner, and those who could access condoms, were more likely to use contraceptives.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti mu mawanga gombi, abantu abalina abaagalwa abasukka mu omu, n’abo abasobola okufuna kondomu, baali basuubirwa nnyo okukozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún ri pé, ní orílẹ̀-èdè méjèèjì, àwọn tó ní ju àwọn alájọṣe kan lọ, àti àwọn àǹfàní sí àwọn rọ́bà ìdáàbòbò, ló ṣeéṣe láti lo àwọn ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde bathola ukuthi, kuwo womabili la mazwe, labo abanabalingani abangaphezu koyedwa, nalabo abakwazi ukuthola amakhondomu, maningi amathuba okuba basebenzise izivikelanzalo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma gano cewa, a cikin ƙasashen biyu, waɗanda suke da abokan hulda fiye da ɗaya, da waɗanda suke iya samun kwaroron roba, sun fi yin amfani da maganin hana haihuwa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše le gore, ka dinageng ka bobedi, bao ba bego ba na le molekane wa go feta o tee, le bao ba bego ba ka hwetša dikhontomo, go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore ba ka šomiša dithibelapelegi.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪ እንዳገኙት በሁለቱም ሃገሮች ከአንድ በላይ የፍቅር ጓደኛ ያላቸው እና ኮንዶም ማግኘት የሚችሉ ሰዎች የወሊድ መቆጣጠሪያ ዘዴዎችን የመጠቀም አዝማሚያቸው ከፍተኛ ነው፡፡

Source: They said more than 67% of youth had access to media channels such as radio, TV and/or internet in both countries.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abavubuka abasukka mu bitundu 67% baali bakozesa emikutu gy’empuliziganya nga leediyo, ttivvi ne/oba yintaneeti mu mawanga gombi.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tó ju 67% ní àǹfàní àti lo àwọn ìmerọ oníròyìn bíi ẹ̀rọ asọ̀rọ̀mágbèsì, TV àti/ tabí ẹ̀rọ ayélujára ní orílẹ̀-èdè méjéèjì.
Zulu: Bathe angaphezu kwama-67% entsha ekwazi ukuthola iziteshi zabezindaba ezifana nomsakazo, i-TV kanye/noma i-intanethi kuwo omabili la mazwe.
Hausa: Sun ce fiye da kashi 67% na matasa na samun damar shiga tashoshin kafafen yaɗa labarai kamar rediyo, TV da/ko intanet a ƙasashen biyu.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore bafsa bao ba fetago 67% ba bile le phihlelelo go ditšhanele tša bobegaditaba tše bjalo ka radio, TV le/goba inthanete ka dinageng ka bobedi.
Amharic: በሁለቱም ሃገሮች ከ67% በላይ የሚሆኑ ወጣቶች እንደሬዲዮ ቲቪ እና/ወይም ኢንተርኔት የመሰሉ የሚዲያ ጣቢያዎችን የማግኘት አቅም ነበራቸው፡፡

Source: Unlike in Nigeria though, youth in Burkina Faso who were exposed to radio or TV, knew more about contraceptives and were more likely to use them.
Luganda: Wabula, obutafaanana Nigeria, abavubuka mu Burkina Faso abaali bakozesa leediyo ne ttivvi baali bamanyi bingiko ebikwata ku nkola z’ekizaalaggumba era baali basuubirwa nnyo okuzikozesa.
Yoruba: Yàtọ̀ sí Nigeria, àwọn ọ̀dọ́ ní Burkina Faso tí wọn ní àǹfàní sí ẹ̀rọ asọ̀rọ̀mágbèsì tàbí TV, mọ̀ púpọ̀ nípa àwọn ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́, àti pé, ó ṣeéṣe kí wọ́n lò wọ́n.
Zulu: Ngokungafani naseNigeria nokho, intsha yaseBurkina Faso eyayichayeke emsakazweni noma kumabonakude, yayazi kabanzi ngezivikelanzalo futhi maningi amathuba okuba izisebenzise.
Hausa: Ba kamar a Nijeriya ba, ko da yake, matasa a Burkina Faso da suka san rediyo ko TV, sun fi sanin maganin hana haihuwa kuma suna iya amfani da su.
Northern Sotho: Eupša go fapana le ka Nigeria, bafsa ba Burkina Faso bao ba bego ba theeletša radio goba go bogela TV, ba be ba tseba kudu ka ga dithibelapelegi le gona go be go na le kgonagalo ya gore ba ka di šomiša.
Amharic: ከናይጄሪያ በሚጻረር መልኩ በቡርኪናፋሶ ለሬዲዮ ወይም ለቲቪ ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ወጣቶች ስለወሊድ መከላኪያ ዘዴዎች የሚያውቁ ሲሆን እነሱን የመጠቀም እድላቸውም ከፍተኛ ነበር፡፡

Source: They also said that almost half (48.8% in Burkina Faso and 48.3% in Nigeria) of those who had access to information knew about sexually transmitted infections.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti kyenkana kimu kyakubiri (48.8% mu Burkina Faso ne 48.3% mu Nigeria) eky’abo abaali basobola okufuna obubaka baali bamanyi ebikwata ku ndwadde z’obukaba.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé àwọn ọ̀dọ́ tó ku díẹ̀ kí wọ́n tó ìdajì (48.8% ní Burkina Faso àti 48.3% ní Nigeria) tí wọ́n ní àǹfàní sí ìròyìn mọ̀ nípa àwọn àrùn nípasẹ̀ ìbálòpọ̀.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi cishe ingxenye (48.8% eBurkina Faso nama-48.3% eNigeria) yalabo abathole ulwazi bayazi ngezifo ezithathelana ngokocansi.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce kusan rabi kashi (48.8% a Burkina Faso da 48.3% a Nijeriya) na waɗanda suke da damar samun bayanai sun san cututtukan da ake ɗauka ta hanyar jima'i.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore palo ye e ka lekanago seripagare (48.8% ka Burkina Faso le 48.3% ka Nigeria) ya bao ba fihleletšego tshedimošo ba bego ba tseba ka ga malwetši ao a ka fetetšwago ka tsela ya thobalano.
Amharic: በተጨማሪ መረጃ ማግኘት ከሚችሉት ግማሽ ያህሉ (48.8% በቡርኪናፋሶ እና 48.3% በናይጄሪያ) በግብረስጋ ግንኙነት ስለሚተላለፉ ኢንፌክሽኖች ያውቁ ነበር፡፡

Source: The researchers said this was the first paper to consider, during data analysis, that the decision by youth to use contraceptives was also influenced by personal and social behaviours.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti luno lwe lupapula olwasooka okutunuulira, mu kwekaliriza obubaka, nti okusalawo kw’abavubuka okukozesa enkola z’ekizaalaggumba kusinziira ne ku nneeyisa z’omuntu kinnoomu n’enkolagana ye n’abalala.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí sọ pé èyí ni ìwé àkọ́kọ́ tí yóó ṣàgbéyèwò, lásìkò ìtúpalẹ̀ dátà, pé ìpinnu àwọn ọ̀dọ́ láti lo àwọn ògùn adátọ̀lọ́wọ́ jẹ́ ohun tó nípá nípasẹ̀ àwọn ìwá ara-ẹni àti ìbáṣe láàárín àwùjọ.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi leli kwakuyiphepha lokuqala okufanele licatshangwe, ngesikhathi sokuhlaziya ingcobelelo, ukuthi isinqumo sentsha sokusebenzisa izivikelanzalo sithelelwe nawukuziphatha komuntu siqu kanye nokomphakathi.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce wannan ita ce takarda ta farko da za a yi la’akari da ita, yayin nazarin bayanai, cewa matakin da matasa suka ɗauka na yin amfani da maganin hana haihuwa yana da tasiri a kan halayen mutum da zamantakewa.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore sengwalwa se e bile sa mathomo go akanya, nakong ya tshekatsheko ya datha, gore sephetho ka bafsa sa go šomiša dithibelapelegi se be se huetšwa ke maitshwaro a bona le a leago.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ እንዳሉት በመረጃ ትንተና ወቅት ወጣቶች የወሊድ መከላከያ ዘዴዎችን መጠቀም አለመጠቀማቸው በግላዊ እና በማህበራዊ ባህሪያት ተጽእኖ እንደሚደረግበት ለማሰስ ይህ ከግምት ውስጥ መግባት ያለበት የመጀመሪያው የጥናት ወረቀት ነው፡፡

Source: The researchers said that their study did not specifically focus on sex education, but rather on the general exposure to school education.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okunoonyereza kwabwe tekwasongera ddala ku kusomesebwa bya kwegatta, wabula ku kusoma okw’awamu mu ssomero.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà sọ pé ìwádìí wọn ò kọjúmọ́ ẹ̀kọ́ ìbálòpọ̀ ní pàtó, ṣuùgbọ́n lórí ìṣirasílẹ̀ gbogbogbò fún ẹ̀kọ́ iléèwé.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ucwaningo lwabo alugxilanga kakhulu emfundweni yezocansi, kodwa kunalokho ekuchayekeni okujwayelekile emfundweni yesikole.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce binciken da suka yi bai mayar da hankali a kan ilimin jima'i musamman ba, a'a, a kan yadda ake yawan samun ilimin makaranta.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dinyakišišo tša bona ga se tša tloga di bea šedi go thuto ya tša thobalano, eupša go seo ba ithutilego ka kakaretšo go thuto ya sekolong.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ጥናታቸው በተለይም የግብረስጋ ግንኙነት ትምህርት ላይ ሳይሆን በጥቅሉ የትምህርት ቤት ትምህርት ላይ እንዳተኮረ ይገልጻሉ፡፡

Source: This is because information about sex education specifically was not available.
Luganda: Kino kyali bwekiti kubanga ebikwatira ddala ku kusoma eby’okwegatta tebyaliwo.
